# Final Goal of the Course

By the end of the semester, students should be able to:

- think computationally about economic problems
- clean and analyze real-world datasets
- build predictive and forecasting systems
- critically use AI tools
- communicate analytical findings professionally
- evaluate ethical implications of algorithmic systems
